- **B02, B04, B08** — Use block capitals on the form. In B04, put your first name and middle name in the same blank, in that order, separated by a space. In B08, add your birth town or country by hand if the restored value omits either.
- **B03** — If the restored date uses a different order, write it by hand as day, month, year.
- **B05** — Enter your NHS number privately if you know it. Otherwise, leave the field blank.
- **B09, B10, B15** — Enter your new Leeds address and postcode by hand in B09 and B10. I’ve assumed this is your first UK GP registration, so repeat the Leeds address in B15.
- **B18–B20** — If you’re returning from the Armed Forces, these fields need your address before enlisting, service or personnel number, and enlistment date, respectively.
- **B23–B24** — Sign by hand and enter the date you sign.
